items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: He had a job for me up at Amherst. ... He had Nathan Davis, Dr. Nathan Davis, from the University of Pittsburgh on tenor.

ctx.x: Then I moved up to Brooklyn, moved out to the house that Billy Higgins, drummer, was living in. Gloria and I took a ground-floor apartment and moved the furniture from Philly over there -- piano and everything. But by then, I was drinking this vodka like it was going out of style and Gloria started seeing what it was doing to me and suggested, 'Let's get into A.A.' She join Al-Anon. Tried that and tried it. I failed. Kept trying. During this period, Blackwell called me up. He had a job for me up at Amherst. It…

ar, workshop. He had Nathan Davis, Dr. Nathan Davis, from the University of Pittsburgh on tenor. We had Clifford Clifton Thornton -- well, Clifford played some kind of East Indian instrument. Bill Cole was the major voice in giving this.
